1.text: SURPRISE!!!! 5 days ago I asked you if you'd ever celebrated Christmas with an Advent calendar, and when you said no, I decided to make you one. So here it is, made by me, just for you. Every day until Christmas Eve a new little door opens with something I picked or wrote thinking of you: a message, a photo, a song, maybe a silly voice note. Some doors I'm still working on, so if one isn't ready yet, be patient, it's coming 😉. I hope that every morning in December you wake up knowing there's something waiting for you, because you deserve to feel that someone is thinking about you every single day. Merry Christmas, Ninny 🎄
